fullDescription: A high-end logistics and heavy machinery listing style featuring a dark glassmorphism aesthetic. It utilizes deep navy backgrounds with animated gradients, 3D perspective cards, and high-contrast typography. Optimized for industrial SaaS, logistics marketplaces, and automotive showrooms, the design prioritizes trust and clarity through verified badges, structured specification grids, and sticky call-to-action sidebars. Key features include scroll-reveal animations, shimmer effects, and interactive 3D hover states.
prompt:
## Resumo
A futuristic dark-mode detail page for asset listings, combining glassmorphism with 3D interactive elements and a high-information density layout.

## Estilo Visual
Create a UI with a dark glassmorphism aesthetic. Background: #050811 with a subtle carbon-fiber texture overlay at 20% opacity. Use a background gradient animation: linear-gradient(-45deg, #050811, #1e3a8a, #0f172a, #172554) with a 400% size and 15s duration. Typography: Headings in 'Cabinet Grotesk' (Extrabold, 700-800), body in 'Satoshi' (Regular, Medium, Bold). Colors: Primary Blue (#2563EB), Success Emerald (#10B981), Warning Amber (#FBBF24), Text White (#F8FAFC), Secondary Text (#94A3B8). Glass Effect: background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03), backdrop-filter: blur(12px), border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08). 3D Animation: perspective: 1000px, transition: transform 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1). Scroll reveal: translate from 30px down to 0, opacity 0 to 1 over 0.8s.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Fixed Header
A fixed top navigation bar. Use a 'glass' container with rounded-2xl corners, 12px padding. Left: Logo with a blue background icon (#2563EB) and bold text. Center: Text-only links in gray-400, changing to white on hover. Right: High-contrast CTA button (White bg, black text) and a menu icon.

### Breadcrumbs and Hero Header
A thin breadcrumb trail (font-size: 14px) using chevron icons. Below, a header section featuring a pill-shaped 'Status' badge (Emerald bg for 'Available') and a large H1 heading. Right-aligned 'Estimated Rate' text with Rs/Trip or Price/Unit units in 4xl font-size.

### Image Gallery
A large main featured image (aspect-video) inside a glass frame with 2.5rem border-radius. Includes a bottom-left 'maximize' button. Below, a 4-column grid of smaller thumbnail images with hover ring effects (blue-500). The last thumbnail should have an overlay (+X more) to indicate more images.

### Specifications Grid
A grid of 3 columns (2 on mobile). Each cell is a glass card with 6px padding. Elements: Lucide icon in blue-500, small uppercase gray-500 label, and bold 18px value text.

### Sticky Sidebar
A sidebar that sticks at top-32. Contains two main cards. 1. Owner Profile: Profile image with a verified checkmark badge, name, rating star, and primary CTAs (WhatsApp Green #22C55E and a Glass-style Call button). 2. Inquiry Form: Simple vertical form with labels in uppercase tracking-widest style and dark inputs (white/5 bg).

### Related Listings Grid
A 3-column grid section at the bottom. Use the TruckCard3D component: a card with 3D tilt effects, a large image top, status tags, and specification summaries in a 2x2 internal grid.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### TruckCard3D — Interactive 3D tilt listing card
Create a card with 'perspective: 1000px'. On mousemove, apply 'rotateX' and 'rotateY' based on cursor position relative to center (delta/15) and 'translateY(-10px)'. Visuals: glass background, 2.5rem border-radius, internal 2rem radius for image. Top badges for availability. Internal 2-column grid for 'Type' and 'Owner' attributes. Bottom WhatsApp button (#22C55E) with shimmer animation.

### Shimmer Effect — Loading/Interaction shimmer overlay
Apply an '::after' pseudo-element to cards. Background: linear-gradient(45deg, transparent, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05), transparent). Rotate 45deg. Animation: move from left -50% to 150% over 6 seconds infinitely.

style.description: The style is defined by a 'Dark Glassmorphism' theme. It pairs the geometric 'Cabinet Grotesk' for bold headings with the modern 'Satoshi' for UI and body text. The palette is dominated by a deep background (#050811) with vibrant accents: Blue (#2563EB) for primary actions, Emerald (#10B981) for availability, and Amber (#FBBF24) for ratings and critical specs. Components feature semi-transparent backgrounds (rgba(255,255,255,0.03)) and thin borders (rgba(255,255,255,0.08)) with a 12px backdrop blur. Animations include a slow-moving background gradient and scroll-triggered transitions using a 0.8s cubic-bezier curve.
